describe: The image shows a revolver-style pistol seen from the side: a long dark barrel to the left, a grey metal frame with a square recessed panel and a round cylinder, a small round knob, and a rounded wooden grip in warm orange-brown at the right. A row of thin vertical dark bars sits below the barrel, and a dark round smudge lies at the lower left. The metal is silver-grey with bright highlights, lit from the upper right.
